value.title: Fork drain, deletion, and surface cleanup

BIDIRECTIONAL fork-drain checklist AND full conversion inventory BEFORE any deletion (sol F1-F3 widened it from commit-history to LIVE CONSUMERS): enumerate (a) every harness-main commit touching services/dd or acts/dd since the fork point - sha + adjudication (ported / deferred / dies-with-fork); (b) every dd-side fix the fork never took (known: shouldExcludeFromSweep E436 reorder, crab in-flight; the unstaged-rollback fix, dd o-prime sequencing); (c) every LIVE consumer of the fork with a per-row conversion/retirement adjudication: production imports (services/flow/{chores-read,flow-dd-gate,flow-events,flow-mutations,flow-renderer}.ts + services/doctor/doctor-service.ts), the ~60 test files matching fork paths (fork-owned dies vs consumer-contract converts), build/check surfaces (gen:dd-docs, check:dd-docs, test/acts/dd.test.ts, dd-doctor sensor, dependency-cruiser fork rules), and operating docs/skills/scenarios prescribing harness dd verbs - committed as assets/tasks/phase-3/fork-drain-checklist.md

Delete services/dd + acts/dd (pre-licensed by prime; advance notice with ancestry proof sent as courtesy) and remove harness dd * verb registration; convert the goldens machinery for a fork-less world: gen test + FROZEN_DIGEST pin retire WITH the fork, live-corpus test converts to structural invariants (dw-0016 note), falsifier suite stays green against golden literals; re-aim the dd-fork-divergence seat detector at the four dd-mechanisms copies (ledger drift-surface trigger 2 - a detector watching a deleted tree is silence, not health)
D-2 riders: harness doctor emits a NON-FATAL warning when the standalone dd CLI is absent (and stays silent when present - control both ways); AGENTS.md documents installing the dd CLI

docs/how/consuming-dd.md: the consume route end to end - full-40-char-sha pinning (dd main NOT pinnable, work branch is), the re-pin procedure (report -> dd fixes on branch -> push -> re-pin -> 12s reinstall), the npm-git sandbox caveat, the re-verify trio (pack shape / foreign-port injection / A-2 tracked===null), the CJS no-require caveat on the barrel, and the mechanism-copy drift triggers + sunset (ledger drift-surface section)
D-4: document the retired flow-to-dd boundary at each guard site that goes blind (comment naming the retirement, or remove the blind guard) plus the plan note - and build NO new package-aware guard

plan-new fixes bundle (ledger #1 harness-fallback + #2): plan new seeds ALL declared sections (closes the E450 authoring workaround harness-side) and gains --ordinal (or ordinal-aware slug resolution) so a bare slug no longer mints a second folder with a prefixed meta.slug. SEQUENCING GATE: touches acts/plan/scaffold.ts, which the standing ruling ordered BEHIND #119 - #119 has NOT landed (verified against origin/main at phase-3 open); prime re-rules the order before this task starts

Close-out at the final boundary: dogfood pair green on the fork-less build against plan 080's own documents; dogfood ledger closes to ZERO silent workarounds (every row CLOSED by working fix or explicitly Jordan-ruled); tsc + full suite green - the three every-phase-boundary ACs (ac-0003, ac-000b, ac-000c) earn their genuine satisfies HERE, resolving their standing orphans

F3 command-surface migration: every operating surface that prescribes the removed harness dd verb family migrates to the standalone dd CLI or is explicitly retired - docs/how/dd/**, the builder skill references (8 files under skills/builder/references), and the dd-native-builder eval scenario (live-testing/scenarios/dd-native-builder/assertions.json executable command) - per the checklist adjudication; historical records (.harness/records, archived plans, retros) are exempt as frozen provenance

tk-000c.assertion: assets/tasks/phase-3/fork-drain-checklist.md is committed BEFORE the deletion commit (git order is the proof) and carries ALL THREE inventories - (a) harness-main commit history with shas + adjudications, (b) dd-side fixes the fork never took incl. the walk.ts E436 row, (c) the live-consumer conversion inventory: every production import, test file class, build/check/sensor/arch-rule surface, and doc/skill/scenario command reference, each with an explicit convert / retire / dies-with-fork adjudication - no consumer reaches the deletion commit unadjudicated

tk-000d.assertion: test ! -d harness/cli/src/services/dd AND test ! -d harness/cli/src/acts/dd; repo-wide grep for their import paths returns zero matches across src/ and test/; verb-removal proof is TEMPORALLY BOUND (sol F4): a named working-verb command (node harness/cli/bin/harness.js dd validate <doc>) runs successfully and is logged BEFORE the deletion commit, and the same command errors unknown-command AFTER it - both outputs in the execution log with commit order; just build && just test green

the goldens gen test and the FROZEN_DIGEST pin are retired IN THE SAME COMMIT as the fork deletion (never before); the live-corpus test now asserts structural invariants (non-vacuity, shape) instead of fork-equality; the falsifier suite still passes against the golden LITERALS

SPLIT RESPONSIBILITY (coder's premise-gap finding, koala's ruling): the dd-fork-divergence detector is a SEAT-SIDE pij chore on koala's seat, not repo code - the research dossier's present-tense H-03 made an aspiration read as a repo fact. KOALA'S half (DONE 2026-08-09, before deletion): the chore is re-aimed to watch dd movement beyond pin a37a20ec on the four copied mechanism files (src/core/{constants,derive,rel,value}.ts vs origin/s002/sdk-build), with an explicit NOT-PROBEABLE arm when the dd clone is absent; first run = empty diff = clean baseline, acked. CODER'S half: record in the execution log the in-repo not-probeable evidence (the greps proving no such detector exists as repo code) - the in-repo casualty is the dd-doctor SENSOR, which is dw-0023's row, not this one
tk-000d.note: materiality ruling: option (a) CREATE-in-repo was rejected - the detector was never repo code, so no new surface and no touch-set growth; thresholds not tripped. Sibling seat chore dd-consumed-surface-wip (probes fork plan files in the win-path-family worktree) also retires/re-aims at deletion - koala's, noted here so the boundary sweep checks it

tk-000d.assertion: F1 conversion: the six production consumers (services/flow/{chores-read,flow-dd-gate,flow-events,flow-mutations,flow-renderer}.ts, services/doctor/doctor-service.ts) import zero fork paths - each rewired onto @ai-substrate/dd public subpaths or the promoted plan-semantics module per the checklist adjudication; test files adjudicated fork-owned (retire with the tree) vs consumer-contract (converted and green) - none deleted merely for referencing the fork

F2 build/proof surfaces: gen:dd-docs (script + package.json build wiring), check:dd-docs, test/acts/dd.test.ts, the dd-doctor sensor, and every dependency-cruiser fork rule are each retired or re-aimed per the checklist; tree absence is asserted AFTER a full just build (the generator must not resurrect or require the tree), not only before it

tk-000e.assertion: harness doctor with the dd CLI absent from PATH emits exactly one non-fatal warning naming the install route; with dd present it emits none - BOTH control runs captured in the execution log; AGENTS.md carries the install documentation

tk-000f.assertion: docs/how/consuming-dd.md exists, passes markdown lint, and carries all six named contents: sha pinning + branch-not-main, re-pin procedure, sandbox caveat, re-verify trio, CJS no-require caveat, drift triggers + sunset

tk-0010.assertion: each guard site that goes blind carries the D-4 retirement comment (or the blind guard is removed) - grep proves; the plan note exists; git diff shows NO new guard was added

tk-0011.assertion: prime's sequencing ruling on #119-vs-this-bundle is recorded in the execution log BEFORE the first scaffold.ts commit; a bare 'plan new dd-consume-upgrade --ordinal 80' (or the ruled equivalent) reproduces this plan's folder shape with a CLEAN meta.slug (ledger #2's pre-agreed acceptance test)
tk-0011.note: sequencing-gated on prime; ledger #2's acceptance test was pre-agreed at entry time

tk-0011.assertion: plan new seeds ALL sections the resolved schema declares (dd validate on a fresh scaffold shows zero declared-but-absent sections); the E450 seed-then-validate workaround is thereby retired harness-side and ledger #1's harness half moves to CLOSED
tk-0011.note: ledger #1 fallback - dd's implicit-create remains dd-side and closes by re-pin whenever it ships

tk-0012.assertion: every dogfood-ledger row reads CLOSED (working fix) or carries Jordan's explicit ruling - zero silent workarounds; human-tier review of the ledger is recorded

at the final boundary on the fork-less build: tsc --noEmit exit 0, full vitest suite green, and node harness/cli/bin/harness.js flow orient + rail + plan validate all ok against plan 080's own documents

tk-0013.assertion: a NON-HISTORICAL zero-reference proof: git grep for the harness dd verb surface (harness dd , harness.js dd , dd doctor as a harness verb) across docs/how, skills/, live-testing/scenarios returns zero prescriptive matches (frozen provenance under .harness/records, docs/plans/archive, and retro records exempt and the exemption list named in the log); each migrated surface names its replacement (standalone dd CLI invocation) and the eval scenario still dry-scores with every placeholder reading ?
